57dbcb263c3f127443a8.en: We live on planet Earth. It is round like a ball.
57dbcb263c3f127443a8.id: Kita tinggal di planet Bumi (Earth). Bumi bulat seperti bola.

53003f7d6bd6d7c8f06f.en: Most of the Earth is covered by water. The rest is land.
53003f7d6bd6d7c8f06f.id: Sebagian besar Bumi tertutup air. Sisanya daratan.

ef78444d065f43f2a44c.en: The Sun is a star. It gives us light and heat.
ef78444d065f43f2a44c.id: Matahari (Sun) adalah bintang. Matahari memberi kita cahaya dan panas.

e3e4915bb938ab40bdc7.en: The Sun is very big, but it is very far away.
e3e4915bb938ab40bdc7.id: Matahari sangat besar, tetapi letaknya sangat jauh.

846fb2406a5f5dddd466.en: Never look straight at the Sun. It can hurt your eyes.
846fb2406a5f5dddd466.id: Jangan pernah menatap Matahari secara langsung. Itu bisa menyakiti matamu.
